candidates.tagline: Petpogo built a smartphone for your dog — it even 'calls' you when the dog escapes
candidates.story: At IFA 2026 in Berlin, Petpogo unveiled the upgraded PetPhone, a pet collar marketed as 'the world's first AI smartphone for pets' that uses a vocalization model trained on millions of animal sounds to translate pet emotions into human language, supports two-way PetChat audio, and theoretically lets pets initiate calls on their own.
candidates.why_funny: Petpogo applied the full smartphone product stack — calls, AI emotion insights, geo-fencing, push notifications, companion app — to an animal that cannot read, speak, or dial.
candidates.alt: Petpogo PetPhone AI pet collar ecosystem product photo showing the compact wearable device alongside its companion app and PetCam components

candidates.tagline: A full robot vacuum — engineered exclusively to clean the thing you sleep on
candidates.story: Creatulize unveiled the X1 Pro at IFA 2026 in Berlin, an autonomous robot vacuum with 11 precision sensors, UV-C LEDs, and specialized silicone wheels designed entirely to roam the surface of your mattress, because standard robot vacuums were failing to address the one surface they don't reach.
candidates.why_funny: They packed a full autonomous robot's worth of sensors, navigation, and UV sanitation into a device whose entire purpose is vacuuming the one thing the robot vacuum already parked next to it can't reach.
candidates.alt: Creatulize X1 Pro autonomous bed-cleaning robot photographed on top of a mattress, showing the compact white device with its silicone wheels and sensor array
